title: Anisotropic elliptic coax: rotated permittivity tensor (electrostatics, analytic)
description:
Coaxial line in a uniaxial crystal (static principal permittivities eps_1 = 43 along the axis at angle theta from +x, eps_2 = 28 across it, lithium-niobate-like), entered as eps_dc_xx / eps_dc_yy / eps_dc_xy of the rotated tensor. Core (terminal at V0) and shield (terminal at 0 V, every cell outside the outer ellipse) are the ellipses rho = a and rho = b of the stretched metric, semi-axes a sqrt(eps_i / eps_bar), turned with theta. The sweep turns the crystal and both ellipses together over 0-90 deg (30 deg last, so the line curves show a rotated case).
Analytic (stretched coordinates u / sqrt(eps_1), v / sqrt(eps_2) along the principal axes): V = V0 ln(b / rho) / ln(b / a), rho = sqrt(eps_bar (u^2 / eps_1 + v^2 / eps_2)), eps_bar = sqrt(eps_1 eps_2); C' = 2 pi eps0 eps_bar / ln(b / a), independent of theta.
E stays -grad V; D adds the cross part -eps0 eps_dc_xy (dV/dy, dV/dx) averaged over each cell's 2x2 blocks (help of eps_dc_xy); no D or field-energy check here.
Derived values tab: C_per_m (core charge / voltage), Q_shield (= -C' V0) and V_probe (probe 40 cells along +x) with their references; expect ~1 % (staircased ellipses).
Sweep tab: C_per_m vs theta, flat (dashed).
Line profile tab (theta = 30 deg): V_along_x / V_along_y (field V), E_x_along_x and E_y_along_x (field E_y: nonzero on the x axis only because the tensor is rotated; drawn without a tolerance: the stepped ellipse edges overshoot and blunt it next to both conductors at any dx, and the max-error score does not converge there, while C_vs_theta and V_probe check the cross term).

parameters.name: V0
parameters.description: core voltage [V]; the shield is held at 0 V

parameters.name: a_core
parameters.description: core size: the stretched radius rho = a of the core ellipse

parameters.name: b_shield
parameters.description: shield size: the stretched radius rho = b of the shield ellipse

parameters.name: eps_1
parameters.description: static relative permittivity along the principal axis at angle theta

parameters.name: theta_deg
parameters.description: rotation of the principal axis (and both ellipses) from +x in degrees (swept)

parameters.name: L_box
parameters.description: domain side; the shield fills every cell outside the outer ellipse

parameters.name: x_probe
parameters.description: probe x relative to the axis (a cell centre)

parameters.name: y_probe
parameters.description: probe y relative to the axis (a cell centre)

analytic_curves.name: V_along_x
analytic_curves.expression: V0*log(b_shield/min(max(sqrt(eps_bar*(((x - x_c)*c_t + (y - y_c)*s_t)**2/eps_1 + ((y - y_c)*c_t - (x - x_c)*s_t)**2/eps_2)), a_core), b_shield))/log(b_shield/a_core)

analytic_curves.name: V_along_y
analytic_curves.expression: V0*log(b_shield/min(max(sqrt(eps_bar*(((x - x_c)*c_t + (y - y_c)*s_t)**2/eps_1 + ((y - y_c)*c_t - (x - x_c)*s_t)**2/eps_2)), a_core), b_shield))/log(b_shield/a_core)

analytic_curves.name: E_x_along_x
analytic_curves.expression: where((eps_bar*(((x - x_c)*c_t + (y - y_c)*s_t)**2/eps_1 + ((y - y_c)*c_t - (x - x_c)*s_t)**2/eps_2) > a_core**2)*(eps_bar*(((x - x_c)*c_t + (y - y_c)*s_t)**2/eps_1 + ((y - y_c)*c_t - (x - x_c)*s_t)**2/eps_2) < b_shield**2), V0*(((x - x_c)*c_t + (y - y_c)*s_t)*c_t/eps_1 - ((y - y_c)*c_t - (x - x_c)*s_t)*s_t/eps_2)/((((x - x_c)*c_t + (y - y_c)*s_t)**2/eps_1 + ((y - y_c)*c_t - (x - x_c)*s_t)**2/eps_2)*log(b_shield/a_core)), 0)

analytic_curves.name: E_y_along_x
analytic_curves.expression: where((eps_bar*(((x - x_c)*c_t + (y - y_c)*s_t)**2/eps_1 + ((y - y_c)*c_t - (x - x_c)*s_t)**2/eps_2) > a_core**2)*(eps_bar*(((x - x_c)*c_t + (y - y_c)*s_t)**2/eps_1 + ((y - y_c)*c_t - (x - x_c)*s_t)**2/eps_2) < b_shield**2), V0*(((x - x_c)*c_t + (y - y_c)*s_t)*s_t/eps_1 + ((y - y_c)*c_t - (x - x_c)*s_t)*c_t/eps_2)/((((x - x_c)*c_t + (y - y_c)*s_t)**2/eps_1 + ((y - y_c)*c_t - (x - x_c)*s_t)**2/eps_2)*log(b_shield/a_core)), 0)
